description: Codex hooks for session context, browser-intent guidance, destructive/publish protection, apply_patch path policy, and HammerTime

hooks.command: BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT="${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-context.sh"; if [ ! -f "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT" ]; then BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT=$(ls -t "$HOME/.codex/plugins/cache/b-open-io/core/"*/hooks/session-context.sh 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); fi; if [ -f "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT" ]; then BOPEN_HOOK_RUNTIME=codex bash "$BOPEN_HOOK_SCRIPT"; fi
